concepts.description: The ordered path into this harness for someone new, where each step states why it comes where it does.
concepts.notes: the learning door, paired with index.md as the reference door | 6 ordered steps each carrying an explicit WHY clause | ends in one traced vertical slice from /start-work through pr-validation.yml to HITL merge, every hop a real concept | claims verified against source at fd0fc6a: RTE tools are Read/Bash/Grep only, exit states are the literal strings 'Ready for QAS' and 'Approved for RTE', QAS performs independent verification
